items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of exemption
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
items.computation: Letter is dated (and, per its own Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung, posted) 01.09.2025, a Monday. The Kreis is a general administrative authority (not a Finanzamt), so under Landesverwaltungsverfahrensrecht the letter is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days from 01.09.2025 (not counted itself): 02.09. (1), 03.09. (2), 04.09. (3), 05.09. (4) -> deemed delivery Friday 05.09.2025. For a general authority this deemed-delivery day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday. The one-month Widerspruch period (Sec. 70 VwGO) then runs from 05.09.2025 under Sec. 187(1), 188(2) BGB: the day of delivery is not counted, and the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 05.10.2025. That date is a Sunday, so under Sec. 31(3) VwVfG SH the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 06.10.2025 (no intervening public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein).
